title: Program and Loan Amount Changes on a Builder Extended Rate Lock
content:
A change of loan program or loan amount on a Builder Extended Rate Lock is written as a terms change on the lock, and the change decides whether the locked rate is re-priced and whether a fee is charged.

## Rules

- **Program change.** A change of loan program carries a program change fee of the term's program change fee percent of the new loan amount, rounded half up to the cent, and re-prices the locked rate as at lock for the new program using the par rate on the change date. The lock term restarts only where the term's program change restarts it.
- **Loan amount rise within the allowance.** A rise in the loan amount of no more than the term's allowed rise percent of the amount at lock keeps the locked rate.
- **Larger rise.** A larger rise re-prices the locked rate at the worse of the locked rate and the current offered rate, without a fee.
- **Decrease.** A decrease in the loan amount never re-prices.
- **Status.** A terms change is written only on a lock whose status is requested or locked, as shown on the lock record.

## Branch table

| Change | Locked rate | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| New loan program | Re-priced as at lock for the new program at the change-date par rate | Program change fee on the new loan amount |
| Loan amount up by no more than the allowed rise | Kept | None |
| Loan amount up by more than the allowed rise | The worse of the locked rate and the current offered rate | None |
| Loan amount down | Kept — never re-priced | None stated |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Amount at lock USD 400000.00 and an allowed rise of 5 percent: the allowance is USD 20000.00. A new amount of USD 420000.00 keeps the locked rate; USD 420000.01 re-prices it.
- A program change to a new loan amount of USD 386500.00 with a fee percent of 0.125: 0.125 percent of 386500.00 is 483.125, rounded half up to the cent USD 483.13.
- A lock in status expired, funded, cancelled or withdrawn takes no terms change.
